name: Monitor: relative scalar spread of the imagined futures vs the fork (bimodality) test as an early-warning alarm
written: 2026-10-24 ~05:55, after the exploratory dev run on paired_record_ocl (results/jenga/deep_dive/spread_check.json: best of 40 spread rules = spread30_rel_s3.0, 89.1% of topples warned >= 3 chunks ahead vs fork_3x 70.9% at 12.0% safe alarm rate; at ~8%: 72.7% vs fork_2x 47.3%; at ~16%: 92.7% vs fork_4x 87.3%) and BEFORE any spread value on the held-out set is computed
held_out_set: policy-alone episodes of the margin test (paired_record_m3; the decisions of results/jenga/deep_dive/m3/margin_rows_*, as the disagreement test), the SAME 64 futures per scale as the fork-test rows (same seed)
rule: relative spread, fixed from dev: r = log(spread_plan) - log(spread_hold), spread = variance along the principal axis of the 64 imagined HOLD30 latents per latent dimension, perception + execution errors x3 (eval/spread_check.py); fire if r > tau, tau = the safe-episode quantile that matches fork_3x's alarm rate on the held-out set
primary: share of topple episodes warned >= 3 chunks ahead: spread rule minus fork_3x, one-sided 95% lower bound (paired bootstrap over topple episodes, 10000 draws) > 0
secondary: the same at fork_2x's and fork_4x's alarm rates; the other dev rules (tvar30_rel_s4.0, spread10_plan_s0.5); warned within 8
consequence: if PASS, a closed-loop test of a filter whose barrier is the continuous relative spread (trigger and certificate) is pre-registered separately
analysis: MC_RUN=paired_record_m3 MC_TAG=_m3 python3 eval/spread_check.py analyse + the primary computation in eval/spread_gate.py -> results/jenga/deep_dive/spread_gate_m3.json
